dn21:1.1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Magadhesu viharati, pācīnato Rājagahassa Ambasaṇḍā nāma brāhmaṇagāmo, tass' uttarato Vediyake pabbate Indasāla-guhāyaṃ.
dn21:1.1.3: Tena kho pana samayena Sakkassa devānam indassa ussukkam udapādi Bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
dn21:1.1.4: Atha kho Sakkassa devānam indassa etad ahosi:
dn21:1.1.5: ‘Kahan nu kho Bhagavā etarahi viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho ti?'
dn21:1.1.6: Addasā kho Sakko devānam indo Bhagavantaṃ Magadhesu viharantaṃ, pācīnato Rājagahassa Ambasaṇḍā nāma brāhmaṇa-gāmo, tass' uttarato Vediyake pabbate Indasāla-guhāyaṃ.
dn21:1.1.8: ‘Ayaṃ mārisā Bhagavā Magadhesu viharati, pācīnato Rājagahassa Ambasaṇḍā nāma brāhmaṇagāmo, tass' uttarato Vediyake pabbate Indasāla-guhāyaṃ.
dn21:1.1.9: Yadi pana mārisā mayan taṃ Bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkameyyāma arahantaṃ sammā-sambuddhan ti.'
dn21:1.1.10: ‘Evaṃ bhaddan tavāti' kho devā Tāvatiṃsā Sakkassa devānam indassa paccassosuṃ. 2.
dn21:1.2.1: Atha kho Sakko devānam indo Pañcasikhaṃ Gandhabba-puttaṃ āmantesi:
dn21:1.2.2: ‘Ayaṃ tāta Pañcasikha Bhagavā Magadhesu viharati, pācīnato Rājagahassa Ambasaṇḍā nāma brāhmaṇa-gāmo, tass' uttarato Vediyake pabbate Indasāla-guhāyaṃ.
dn21:1.2.3: Yadi pana tāta Pañcasikha mayan taṃ Bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkameyyāma arahantaṃ sammā-sambuddhan ti.'
dn21:1.2.4: ‘Evaṃ bhaddan tavāti' kho Pañcasikho Gandhabbaputto Sakkassa devānam indassa paṭissutvā beluva-paṇḍu vīṇaṃ ādāya Sakkassa devānam indassa anucariyaṃ upāgami.
dn21:1.2.5: Atha kho Sakko devānam indo devehi Tāvatiṃsehi parivuto Pañcasikhena Gandhabba-puttena purakkhato,
dn21:1.2.6: seyyathā pi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evam evaṃ devesu Tāvatiṃsesu antarahito Magadhesu, pācīnato Rājagahassa Ambasaṇḍā nāma brāhmaṇa-gāmo, tass' uttarato Vediyake pabbate paccuṭṭhāsi. 3.
dn21:1.3.1: Tena kho pana samayena Vediyako pabbato atiriva obhāsa-jāto hoti, Ambasaṇḍā ca brāhmaṇa-gāmo, yathā taṃ devānaṃ devānubhāvena.
dn21:1.3.2: Api 'ssudaṃ parito gāmesu manussā evam āhaṃsu:
dn21:1.3.3: ‘Āditt' assu nām' ajja Vediyako pabbato, pajjhāyit' assu nām' ajja Vediyako pabbato, jalit' assu nām' ajja Vediyako pabbato.
dn21:1.3.4: Kiṃ su nām' ajja Vediyako pabbato atiriva obhāsa-jāto, Ambasaṇḍā ca brāhmaṇa-gāmo' ti
dn21:1.4.1: Atha kho Sakko devānam indo Pañcasikhaṃ Gandhabba-puttaṃ āmantesi:
dn21:1.4.2: ‘Durupasaṃkamā kho tāta Pañcasikha Tathāgatā mādisena, jhāyī jhāna-ratā tadanantaraṃ patisallīnā.
dn21:1.4.3: Yadi pana tāta Pañcasikha Bhagavantaṃ paṭhamaṃ pasādeyyāsi, tayā tāta paṭhamaṃ pasāditaṃ pacchā mayaṃ taṃ Bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkameyyāma arahantaṃ sammā-sambuddhan ti.'
dn21:1.4.4: ‘Evaṃ bhaddan tavāti' kho Pañcasikho Gandhabbaputto Sakkassa devānam indassa paṭissutvā beluva-paṇḍu-vīṇaṃ ādāya yena Indasāla-guhā ten' upasaṃkami. Upasaṃkamitvā:
dn21:1.4.5: ‘Ettāvatā me Bhagavā n' eva atidūre bhavissati na accāsanne, saddañ ca kho sossatīti'
dn21:1.4.8: Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho Pañcasikho Gandhabbaputto beluva-paṇḍu-vīṇaṃ assāvesi imā ca gāthā abhāsi Buddhūpasaṃhitā dhammūpasaṃhitā arahantūpasaṃhitā kāmūpasaṃhitā: 5.
dn21:1.6.1: Evaṃ vutte Bhagavā Pañcasikhaṃ Gandhabbaputtaṃ etad avoca:
dn21:1.6.2: ‘Saṃsandati kho pana te Pañcasikha tantissaro gītassarena gītassaro ca tantissarena,
dn21:1.6.3: na ca pana te Pañcasikha tantissaro ativaṇṇati gītassaraṃ, gītassaro vā tantissaraṃ.
dn21:1.6.4: Kadā saṃyūḷhā pana te Pañcasikha imā gāthā Buddhūpasaṃhitā dhammūpasaṃhitā arahantūpasaṃhitā kāmūpasaṃhitā ti?' ‘Ekam
dn21:1.6.5: ida bhante samayaṃ Bhagavā Uruvelāyaṃ viharati najjā Nerañjarāya tīre Ajapāla-nigrodha-mūle paṭhamābhisambuddho.
dn21:1.6.6: Tena kho panāhaṃ bhante samayena, Bhaddā nāma Suriya-vaccasā Timbaruno Gandhabba-rañño dhītā, tam abhikaṃkhāmi.
dn21:1.6.7: Sā kho pana bhante bhaginī para-kāminī hoti,
dn21:1.6.8: Sikhaddhi nāma Mātalissa saṅgāhakassa putto, tam abhikaṃkhati.
dn21:1.6.9: Yato kho ahaṃ bhante taṃ bhaginiṃ nālatthaṃ kenaci pariyāyena,
dn21:1.6.10: athāhaṃ beluva-paṇḍu-vīṇaṃ ādāya yena Timbaruno Gandhabba-rañño nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṃkamiṃ, upasaṃkamitvā beluva-paṇḍu-vīṇaṃ assāvesiṃ, imā ca gāthā abhāsiṃ Buddhūpasaṃhitā dhammūpasaṃhitā arahantūpasaṃhitā kāmūpasaṃhitā:-- 7.
dn21:1.7.10: ‘Evaṃ vutte bhante Bhaddā Suriya-vaccasā maṃ etad avoca:
dn21:1.7.11: "‘Na kho me mārisa so Bhagavā sammukhā diṭṭho, api ca suto yeva me so Bhagavā devānaṃ Tāvatiṃsānaṃ Sudhammāyaṃ sabhāyaṃ upanaccantiyā.
dn21:1.7.12: Yato kho tvaṃ mārisa taṃ Bhagavantaṃ kittesi, hotu no ajja samāgamo ti."
dn21:1.7.13: ‘So yeva no bhante tassā bhaginiyā saddhiṃ samāgamo ahosi,
dn21:1.7.14: na ca dāni, tato pacchā ti.' 8.
dn21:1.8.1: Atha kho Sakkassa devānam indassa etad ahosi:
dn21:1.8.2: ‘Paṭisammodati kho Pañcasikho Gandhabba-putto Bhagavatā, Bhagavā ca Pañcasikhenāti.'
dn21:1.8.3: Atha kho Sakko devānam indo Pañcasikhaṃ Gandhabba-puttaṃ āmantesi:
dn21:1.8.5: Sakko bhante devānam indo sāmacco saparijano Bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatīti.
dn21:1.8.6: ‘Evaṃ bhaddan tavāti' kho Pañcasikho Gandhabbaputto Sakkassa devānam indassa paṭissutvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādesi:
dn21:1.8.7: ‘Sakko bhante devānam Indo sāmacco saparijano Bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatīti.'
dn21:1.8.8: ‘Sukhī hotu Pañcasikha Sakko devānam indo sāmacco saparijano,
dn21:1.8.9: sukha-kāmā hi deva manussā Asurā Nāgā Gandhabbā ye c' aññe santi puthu-kāyā ti.'
dn21:1.8.10: Evañ ca pana Tathāgatā evarūpe mahesakkhe abhivadanti.
dn21:1.8.11: Abhivādito Sakko devānam indo Bhagavato Indasāla-guhaṃ pavisitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi,
dn21:1.8.12: devā pi Tāvatiṃsā Indasālaguhaṃ pavisitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu,
dn21:1.8.13: Pañcasikho pi Gandhabba-putto Indasālaguhaṃ pavisitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. 9.
dn21:1.9.1: Tena kho pana samayena Indasāla-guhā visamā santī samā sampādi, sambādhā santī urundā sampādi, andha-kāra-guhāyaṃ āloko udapādi, yathā taṃ devānaṃ devānubhāvena.
dn21:1.9.2: Atha kho Bhagavā Sakkaṃ devānaṃ indaṃ etad avoca:
dn21:1.9.3: ‘Acchariyam idaṃ āyasmato Kosiyassa, abbhutam idaṃ āyasmato Kosiyassa, tāva bahu-kiccassa bahu-karaṇīyassa , yad idaṃ idhāgamanan ti?'
dn21:1.9.4: ‘Cira-paṭikāhaṃ bhante Bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamitu-kāmo, api ca devānaṃ Tāvatiṃsānaṃ kehici kehici kicca-karaṇīyehi vyāvaṭo evāhaṃ nāsakkhiṃ Bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamituṃ. Ekam
dn21:1.9.5: ida bhante samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Salaḷāgārake.
dn21:1.9.6: Atha kho 'ham bhante Sāvatthiyaṃ agamāsiṃ Bhagavantaṃ dassanāya. 10.
dn21:1.10.1: ‘Tena kho pana bhante samayena Bhagavā aññatareṇa samādhinā nisinno hoti, Bhuñjatī ca nāma Vessavaṇassa paricārikā Bhagavantaṃ paccupaṭṭhitā hoti pañjalikā namassamānā.
dn21:1.10.2: Atha kho 'haṃ bhante Bhuñjatiṃ etad avocaṃ:
dn21:1.10.4: Sakko bhante devānam indo sāmacco saparijano Bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatīti."
dn21:1.10.8: "‘Tena hi bhagini yadā Bhagavā tamhā samādhimhā vuṭṭhito hoti, atha mama vacanena Bhagavantaṃ abhivādehi:
dn21:1.10.9: Sakko bhante devānam indo sāmacco saparijano Bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatīti."
dn21:1.10.10: Kacci me sā bhante bhaginī Bhagavantaṃ abhivādesi,
dn21:1.10.11: sarati Bhagavā tassā bhaginiyā vacanan ti?'
dn21:1.10.12: ‘Abhivādesi maṃ sā devānam inda bhaginī. Sarām' ahaṃ tassā bhaginiyā vacanaṃ.
dn21:1.10.13: Api cāhaṃ āyasmato ca nemi-saddena tamhā samādhimhā vuṭṭhito ti.' 11.
dn21:1.11.1: ‘Ye te bhante devā amhehi paṭhamataram Tāvatiṃsa-kāyaṃ uppannā, tesam me sammukhā sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ:
dn21:1.11.2: "Yadā Tathāgatā loke uppajjanti arahanto sammā-sambuddhā, dibbā kāyā paripūrenti, hāyanti asura-kāyā ti."
dn21:1.11.3: Tam me idaṃ bhante sakkhi-diṭṭhaṃ yato Tathāgato loke uppanno arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho, dibbā kāyā paripūrenti hāyanti asurakāyā ti.
dn21:1.11.5: Idh' eva bhante Kapilavatthusmiṃ Gopikā nāma Sakya-dhītā ahosi Buddhe pasannā dhamme pasannā saṃghe pasannā sīlesu paripūrakārinī.
dn21:1.11.6: Sā itthicittaṃ virājetvā purisa-cittaṃ bhāvetvā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ uppannā
dn21:1.11.7: devānaṃ Tāvatiṃsānam sahavyataṃ, amhākaṃ puttattaṃ ajjhūpagatā.
dn21:1.11.10: Aññe pi bhante tayo bhikkhū Bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ caritvā hīnaṃ Gandhabbakāyaṃ uppannā.
dn21:1.11.11: Te pañcahi kāma-guṇehi samappitā samaṅgi-bhūtā paricārayamānā amhākaṃ upaṭṭhānaṃ āgacchanti amhākaṃ pāricariyaṃ.
dn21:1.11.12: Te amhākaṃ upaṭṭhānaṃ āgate amhākaṃ pāricariyaṃ Gopako deva-putto paṭicodesi:
dn21:1.11.13: "Kuto-mukhā nāma tumhe mārisā tassa Bhagavato dhammaṃ assutvā?
dn21:1.11.14: Ahaṃ hi itthikā samānā Buddhe pasannā dhamme pasannā saṃghe pasannā sīlesu paripūrakārinī itthi-cittaṃ virājetvā purisacittaṃ bhāvetvā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ uppannā, devānaṃ Tāvatiṃsānaṃ sahavyataṃ Sakkassa devānam Indassa puttattaṃ ajjhūpagatā.
dn21:1.11.17: Tumhe pana mārisā Bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ caritvā hīnaṃ Gandhabba-kāyaṃ uppannā.
dn21:1.11.18: Duddiṭṭha-rūpaṃ vata addasāma, ye mayaṃ addasāma sahadhammike hīnaṃ Gandhabba-kāyaṃ uppanne ti."
dn21:1.11.19: Tesaṃ bhante Gopakena deva-puttena paṭicoditānaṃ dve devā diṭṭhe va dhamme satiṃ paṭilabhiṃsu kāyaṃ Brahmapurohitaṃ. Eko pana devo te va kāme ajjhāvasi.' 12.
dn21:1.12.2: nāmam pi mayhaṃ ahu Gopikā ti,
dn21:1.12.8: jānanti pi maṃ idha Gopako ti.
dn21:1.12.66: na tattha kiṃ kaṃkhati koci sāvako.
dn21:1.13.2: ‘Dīgha-rattaṃ visuddho kho ayaṃ Sakko. Yaṃ kiñci maṃ pañhaṃ pucchissati sabbaṃ taṃ attha-saṃhitaṃ yeva pucchissati no anattha-saṃhitaṃ,
dn21:1.13.3: yam assāhaṃ puṭṭho vyākarissāmi taṃ khippam eva ājānissatīti.'
dn21:1.13.4: Atha kho Bhagavā Sakkaṃ devānam indaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi:-‘Puccha
dn21:2.1.1: Katāvakāso Sakko devānam indo Bhagavantaṃ imaṃ paṭhamaṃ pañhaṃ pucchi:
dn21:2.1.2: ‘Kiṃ-saṃyojanā nu kho mārisa devā manussā asurā nāgā gandhabbā ye c' aññe santi puthukāyā, te:
dn21:2.1.3: averā adaṇḍā asapattā avyāpajjhā viharemu averino ti iti ce nesaṃ hoti atha ca pana saverā sadaṇḍā sasapattā savyāpajjhā viharanti verino ti?'
dn21:2.1.4: Itthaṃ Sakko devānam indo Bhagavantaṃ imaṃ paṭhamaṃ pañhaṃ apucchi.
dn21:2.1.6: ‘Issā-macchariya-saṃyojanā kho devānam inda devā manussā asurā nāgā gandhabbā ye c' aññe santi puthukāyā te
dn21:2.1.7: averā adaṇḍā asapattā avyāpajjhā viharemu averino ti iti ce nesaṃ hoti atha ca pana saverā sadaṇḍā sasapattā savyāpajjhā viharanti verino ti.'
dn21:2.1.8: Itthaṃ Bhagavā Sakkassa devānam indassa pañhaṃ puṭṭho vyākāsi.
dn21:2.1.9: Attamano Sakko devānam indo Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandi anumodi:
dn21:2.1.11: tiṇṇā m' ettha kaṃkhā vigatā kathaṃkathā Bhagavato pañha-veyyākaraṇaṃ sutvā ti.' 2.
dn21:2.2.1: Iti ha Sakko devānaṃ indo Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā Bhagavantaṃ uttariṃ pañhaṃ apucchi:
dn21:2.2.2: ‘Issā-macchariyaṃ pana mārisa kiṃ-nidānaṃ kiṃsamudayaṃ kiṃ-jātikaṃ kiṃ-pabhavaṃ,
dn21:2.2.5: ‘Issā-macchariyaṃ kho devānam inda piyāppiya-nidānaṃ piyāppiya-samudayaṃ piyāppiya-jātikaṃ piyāppiyapabhavaṃ,
dn21:2.2.8: ‘Piyāppiyaṃ pana mārisa kiṃ-nidānaṃ kiṃ-samudayaṃ kiṃ-jātikaṃ kiṃ-pabhavaṃ,
dn21:2.2.11: ‘Piyāppiyaṃ kho devānam inda chanda-nidānaṃ chanda-samudayaṃ chanda-jātikaṃ chanda-ppabhavaṃ,
dn21:2.2.14: ‘Chando pana mārisa kiṃ-nidāno kiṃ-samudayo kiṃjātiko kiṃ-pabhavo,
dn21:2.2.17: ‘Chando kho devānam inda vitakka-nidāno vitakkasamudayo vitakka-jātiko vitakka-pabhavo,
dn21:2.2.20: ‘Vitakko pana mārisa kiṃ-nidāno kiṃ-samudayo kiṃ-jātiko kiṃ-pabhavo,
dn21:2.2.23: ‘Vitakko kho devānam inda papañca-saññā-saṅkhānidāno papañca-saññā-saṅkhā-samudayo papañca-saññāsaṅkhā-jātiko papañca-saññā-saṅkhā-pabhavo,
dn21:2.3.3: ‘Somanassaṃ p' ahaṃ devānam inda duvidhena vadāmi,
dn21:2.3.5: Domanassaṃ p' ahaṃ devānam inda duvidhena vadāmi,
dn21:2.3.6: sevitabbam pi asevitabbam pi. Upekhaṃ p'
dn21:2.3.9: "Somanassaṃ p' ahaṃ devānam inda duvidhena vadāmi, sevitabbam pi asevitabbam pīti," iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ . Kiñ c' etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ?
dn21:2.3.11: Imaṃ kho me somanassaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivāḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyantīti, evarūpam somanassaṃ na sevitabbam.
dn21:2.3.13: Imaṃ kho me somanassaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhantīti, evarūpaṃ somanassaṃ sevitabbaṃ.
dn21:2.3.14: Tattha yañ ce savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ, yañ ce avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ, ye avitakke avicāre se paṇītatare.
dn21:2.3.15: "Somanassaṃ p' ahaṃ devānam inda duvidhena vadāmi sevitabbam pi asevitabbam pīti"
dn21:2.3.16: iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
dn21:2.3.17: "Domanassaṃ p' ahaṃ devānam inda duvidhena vadāmi sevitabbam pi asevitabbam pīti," iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ. Kiñ c' etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ?
dn21:2.3.19: Imaṃ kho me domanassaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyantīti, evarūpaṃ domanassaṃ na sevitabbaṃ.
dn21:2.3.21: Imaṃ kho me domanassaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhantīti, evarūpaṃ domanassaṃ sevitabbaṃ.
dn21:2.3.22: Tattha yañ ce savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ, yañ ce avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ, ye avitakke avicāre se paṇītatare.
dn21:2.3.23: "Domanassaṃ p' ahaṃ devānam inda duvidhena vadāmi sevitabbam pi asevitabbam pīti"
dn21:2.3.24: iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
dn21:2.3.25: "Upekhaṃ p' ahaṃ devānam inda duvidhena vadāmi, sevitabbam pi asevitabbam pīti" iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ kiñ c' etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ?
dn21:2.3.27: Imaṃ kho me upekhaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyantīti, evarūpā upekhā na sevitabbā.
dn21:2.3.29: Imaṃ kho me upekhaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhantīti, evarūpā upekhā sevitabbā.
dn21:2.3.30: Tattha yañ ce savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ, yañ ce avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ, ye avitakke avicāre se paṇītatare.
dn21:2.3.31: "Upekhaṃ p' ahaṃ devānam inda duvidhena vadāmi sevitabbam pi asevitabbam pīti"
dn21:2.3.32: iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ idaṃ etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
dn21:2.3.33: "Evaṃ paṭipanno kho devānam inda bhikkhu papañcasaññā-saṅkhā-nirodha-sāruppa-gāmini-paṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hotīti."
dn21:2.3.34: Itthaṃ Bhagavā Sakkassa devānam indassa pañhaṃ puṭṭho vyākāsi.
dn21:2.3.35: Attamano Sakko devānam Indo Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandi anumodi:
dn21:2.3.37: tiṇṇā m' ettha kaṅkhā vigatā kathaṅkathā Bhagavato pañha-veyyākaraṇaṃ sutvā ti.' 4.
dn21:2.4.1: Iti ha Sakko devānam indo Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā Bhagavantaṃ uttariṃ pañhaṃ apucchi:
dn21:2.4.2: ‘Kathaṃ-paṭipanno pana mārisa bhikkhu pātimokkhasaṃvarāya paṭipanno hotīti?'
dn21:2.4.3: ‘Kāya- samācāraṃ p' ahaṃ devānam inda duvidhena vadāmi,
dn21:2.4.4: sevitabbam pi asevitabbam pi. Vacī-samācāraṃ p'
dn21:2.4.7: Pariyesanaṃ p' ahaṃ devānaṃ inda duvidhena vadāmi,
dn21:2.4.9: ahaṃ devānam inda duvidhena vadāmi, sevitabbam pi asevitabbam pīti," iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ. Kiñ c' etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ?
dn21:2.4.11: Imaṃ kho me kāya-samācāraṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, kusalā dhammā parihāyantīti, evarūpo kāya-samācāro na sevitabbo.
dn21:2.4.13: Imaṃ kho me kāya-samācāraṃ sevato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhantīti, evarūpo kāya-samācāro sevitabbo.
dn21:2.4.14: "Kāya-samācāraṃ p' ahaṃ devānam inda duvidhena vādāmi
dn21:2.4.16: iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
dn21:2.4.17: "Vacī- samācāraṃ p' ahaṃ devānam inda duvidhena vadāmi,
dn21:2.4.18: sevitabbam pi asevitabbam pīti," iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ. Kiñ c' etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ?
dn21:2.4.19: Tattha yaṃ jaññā vacī-samācāraṃ: Imaṃ kho me vacī-samācāraṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, kusalā dhammā parihāyantīti, evarūpo vacī-samācāro na sevitabbo.
dn21:2.4.20: Tattha yaṃ jaññā vacī-samācāraṃ: Imaṃ kho me vacī-samācāraṃ sevato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhantīti , evarūpo vacī-samācāro sevitabbo.
dn21:2.4.21: "Vacī-samācāraṃ p' ahaṃ devānam inda duvidhena vadāmi
dn21:2.4.23: iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
dn21:2.4.24: "Pariyesanaṃ p' ahaṃ devānam inda duvidhena vadāmi,
dn21:2.4.25: sevitabbam pi asevitabbam pīti" iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ. Kiñ c' etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ?
dn21:2.4.26: Tattha yaṃ jaññā pariyesanaṃ: Imaṃ kho me pariyesanaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyantīti, evarūpā pariyesanā na sevitabbā.
dn21:2.4.27: Tattha yaṃ jaññā pariyesanaṃ: Imaṃ kho me pariyesanaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhantīti, evarūpā pariyesanā sevitabbā.
dn21:2.4.28: "Pariyesanaṃ p' ahaṃ devānam inda duvidhena vadāmi,
dn21:2.4.30: iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
dn21:2.4.31: "Evaṃ paṭipanno kho devānam inda bhikkhu pātimokkha-saṃvarāya paṭipanno hotīti.'
dn21:2.4.32: Itthaṃ Bhagavā Sakkassa devānam Indassa pañhaṃ puṭṭho vyākāsi.
dn21:2.4.33: Attamano Sakko devānam Indo Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandi anumodi:
dn21:2.4.35: tiṇṇā m' ettha kaṅkhā vigatā kathaṅkathā Bhagavato pañha-veyyākaraṇaṃ sutvā ti.' 5.
dn21:2.5.1: Iti ha Sakko devānam indo Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā Bhagavantaṃ uttariṃ pañhaṃ apucchi:
dn21:2.5.2: ‘Kathaṃ-paṭipanno pana mārisa bhikkhu indriya saṃvarāya paṭipanno hotīti?'
dn21:2.5.3: ‘Cakkhu-viññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ p' ahaṃ devānam inda duvidhena vadāmi,
dn21:2.5.5: Sotaviññeyyaṃ saddaṃ p' ahaṃ devānam inda . . . pe . . . Ghāna-viññeyyaṃ gandhaṃ p' ahaṃ devānam inda . . . pe . . . Jivhā-viññeyyaṃ rasaṃ p' ahaṃ devānam inda . . . pe . . . Kāya-viññeyyaṃ phoṭṭhabbaṃ p' ahaṃ devānam inda . . . pe . . . Mano-viññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ p' ahaṃ devānam inda duvidhena vadāmi,
dn21:2.5.15: Evaṃ vutte Sakko devānam indo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
dn21:2.5.16: ‘Imassa kho ahaṃ bhante Bhagavatā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmi.
dn21:2.5.17: Yathārūpaṃ bhante cakkhu-viññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyanti, evarūpaṃ cakkhu-viññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ na sevitabbaṃ;
dn21:2.5.18: yathārūpañ ca kho bhante cakkhu-viññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, evarūpaṃ cakkhu- viññeyyaṃ rūpaṃ sevitabbaṃ.
dn21:2.5.19: Yathārūpaṃ ca kho bhante sota-viññeyyaṃ saddaṃ sevato . . . pe . . .
dn21:2.5.23: pe . . . mano-viññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyanti, evarūpo mano-viññeyyo dhammo na sevitabbo.
dn21:2.5.24: Yathārūpañ ca kho bhante mano-viññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, evarūpo mano-viññeyyo dhammo sevitabbo
dn21:2.5.25: -Imassa kho me bhante Bhagavatā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānato
dn21:2.5.26: tiṇṇā m' ettha kaṅkhā vigatā kathaṅkathā Bhagavato pañha-veyyākaraṇaṃ sutvā ti.' 6.
dn21:2.6.1: Iti ha Sakko devānam indo Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā Bhagavantaṃ uttariṃ pañhaṃ apucchi:
dn21:2.6.2: ‘Sabbe va nu kho mārisa samaṇa-brāhmaṇā ekantavādā ekanta-sīlā ekanta-chandā ekanta-ajjhosānā ti?'
dn21:2.6.3: ‘Na kho devānam inda sabbe samaṇa-brāhmaṇā ekantavādā ekanta-sīlā ekanta-chandā ekanta-ajjhosānā ti.'
dn21:2.6.4: ‘Kasmā pana mārisa na sabbe samaṇa-brāhmaṇā ekanta-vādā ekanta-sīlā ekanta-chandā ekanta-ajjhosānā ti?'
dn21:2.6.6: Tasmiṃ aneka-dhātu - nānā-dhātusmiṃ loke yaṃ yad eva sattā dhātuṃ abhinivisanti taṃ tad eva thāmasā parāmassa abhinivissa voharanti:
dn21:2.6.8: Tasmā na sabbe samaṇa-brāhmaṇā ekanta-vādā ekanta-sīlā ekanta-chandā ekanta-ajjhosānā ti.'
dn21:2.6.9: ‘Sabbe va nu kho mārisa samaṇa-brāhmaṇā accantaniṭṭhā accanta-yogakkhemī accanta-brahmacārī accantapariyosānā ti?'
dn21:2.6.10: ‘Na kho devānam inda samaṇa-brāhmaṇā accantaniṭṭhā accanta-yogakkhemī accanta-brahmacārī accantapariyosānā ti.'
dn21:2.6.11: ‘Kasmā pana mārisa na sabbe samaṇa-brāhmaṇā accanta-niṭṭhā accanta-yogakkhemī accanta-brahmacārī accanta-pariyosānā ti?'
dn21:2.6.12: ‘Ye kho te devānam inda samaṇa-brāhmaṇā taṇhāsaṅkhaya-vimuttā, te accanta-niṭṭhā accanta-yogakkhemī accanta-brahmacārī accanta-pariyosānā.
dn21:2.6.13: Tasmā na sabbe samaṇa-brāhmaṇā accanta-niṭṭhā accanta-yogakkhemī accanta-brahmacārī accanta-pariyosānā ti.'
dn21:2.6.14: Itthaṃ Bhagavā Sakkassa devānam indassa pañhaṃ puṭṭho vyākāsi.
dn21:2.6.15: Attamano Sakko devānam Indo Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandi anumodi:
dn21:2.6.17: tiṇṇā m' ettha kaṅkhā, vigatā kathaṅkathā, Bhagavato pañha-veyyākaraṇaṃ sutvā ti.' 7.
dn21:2.6.18: Iti ha Sakko devānam indo Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
dn21:2.7.1: ‘Ejā bhante rogo ejā gaṇḍo ejā sallaṃ ejā imaṃ purisaṃ parikaḍḍhati tassa tass' eva bhavassa abhinipphattiyā,
dn21:2.7.3: Yesāhaṃ bhante pañhānaṃ ito bahiddhā aññesu samaṇa-brāhmaṇesu okāsakammam pi nālatthaṃ, te me Bhagavatā vyākatā dīgharattānusayino,
dn21:2.7.4: yañ ca pana me vicikicchā-kathaṅkathāsallaṃ tañ ca Bhagavatā abbūḷhan ti.'
dn21:2.7.5: ‘Abhijānāsi no tvaṃ devānam inda ime pañhe aññe samaṇa-brāhmaṇe pucchittho ti?'
dn21:2.7.6: "Abhijānām' ahaṃ bhante ime pañhe aññe samaṇabrāhmaṇe pucchitā ti.'
dn21:2.7.7: ‘Yathā-kathaṃ pana te devānam inda vyākaṃsu, sace te agaru, bhāsassūti.'
dn21:2.7.8: ‘Na kho me bhante garu yatth' assa Bhagavā nisinno Bhagavanta-rūpā vā ti.'
dn21:2.7.10: ‘Ye sāhaṃ bhante maññāmi samaṇa-brāhmaṇe: "āraññakā panta-senāsanā" ti tyāhaṃ upasaṃkamitvā ime pañhe pucchāmi. Te mayā puṭṭhā na sampāyanti, asampāyantā mamaṃ yeva paṭipucchanti:
dn21:2.7.13: "Ahaṃ kho mārisa Sakko devānam indo ti."
dn21:2.7.15: "Kim pan' āyasmā devānam indo kammaṃ katvā imaṃ ṭhānaṃ patto ti?"
dn21:2.7.18: "Sakko ca no devānam indo diṭṭho, yañ ca no apucchimhā tañ ca no vyākāsīti."
dn21:2.7.19: Te aññadatthu mamaṃ yeva sāvakā sampajjanti, na cāhaṃ tesaṃ,
dn21:2.7.20: ahaṃ kho pana bhante Bhagavato sāvako, sotāpanno avinipāta-dhammo niyato sambodhi-parāyano ti.'
dn21:2.7.22: ‘Abhijānāsi no tvaṃ devānam inda ito pubbe evarūpaṃ veda-paṭilābhaṃ somanassa-paṭilābhan ti?'
dn21:2.7.23: ‘Abhijānām' ahaṃ bhante ito pubbe evarūpaṃ vedapaṭilābhaṃ somanassa-paṭilābhan ti.'
dn21:2.7.24: ‘Yathā-kathaṃ pana tvaṃ devānam inda abhijānāsi ito pubbe evarūpaṃ veda-paṭilābhaṃ somanassa-paṭilābhan ti?'
dn21:2.7.26: Tasmiṃ kho pana bhante saṃgāme devā jiniṃsu, asurā parājiṃsu.
dn21:2.7.27: Tassa mayhaṃ bhante taṃ saṃgāmaṃ abhivijinitvā vijita-saṃgāmassa etad ahosi:
dn21:2.7.28: "Yā c' eva dāni dibbā ojā, yā va asura-ojā, ubhayam etaṃ devā paribhuñjissantīti."
dn21:2.7.29: Yo kho pana me bhante veda-paṭilābho somanassa-paṭilābho sadaṇḍāvacaro sasatthāvacaro na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati.
dn21:2.7.30: Yo kho pana me ayaṃ bhante Bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā veda-paṭilābho somanassa-paṭilābho, so adaṇḍāvacaro asatthāvacaro ekanta-nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattatīti .' 8.
dn21:2.8.1: ‘Kim pana tvaṃ devānam inda atthavasaṃ sampassamāno evarūpaṃ veda-paṭilābhaṃ somanassa-paṭilābhaṃ pavedesīti?'
dn21:2.8.2: ‘Cha kho ahaṃ bhante atthavase sampassamāno evarūpaṃ veda-paṭilābhaṃ somanassa-paṭilābhaṃ pavedemi.
dn21:2.8.7: ‘Imaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante paṭhamaṃ atthavasaṃ sampassamāno evarūpaṃ veda-paṭilābhaṃ somanassapaṭilābhaṃ pavedemi.
dn21:2.8.12: ‘Imaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante dutiyaṃ atthavasaṃ sampassamāno evarūpaṃ veda-paṭilābhaṃ somanassa-paṭilābhaṃ pavedemi.
dn21:2.8.17: ‘Imaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante tatiyaṃ atthavasaṃ saṃpassamāno evarūpaṃ veda-paṭilābhaṃ somanassa-paṭilābhaṃ pavedemi.
dn21:2.8.22: ‘Imaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante catutthaṃ atthavasaṃ sampassamāno evarūpaṃ veda-paṭilābhaṃ somanassa-paṭilābhaṃ pavedemi.
dn21:2.8.27: ‘Imaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante pañcamaṃ atthavasaṃ sampassamāno evarūpaṃ veda-paṭilābhaṃ somanassa-paṭilābhaṃ pavedemi.
dn21:2.8.32: ‘Imaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante chaṭṭhaṃ atthavasaṃ sampassamāno evarūpaṃ veda-paṭilābhaṃ somanassa-paṭilābhaṃ pavedemi.
dn21:2.8.33: ‘Ime kho ahaṃ bhante cha atthavase sampassamāno evarūpaṃ veda-paṭilābhaṃ somanassa-paṭilābhaṃ pavedemi. 9.
dn21:2.10.1: Atha kho Sakko devānam indo Pañcasikhaṃ gandhabba-puttaṃ āmantesi:
dn21:2.10.2: ‘Bahūpakāro kho me 'si tvaṃ, tāta Pañcasikha, yaṃ tvaṃ Bhagavantaṃ paṭhamaṃ pasādesi.
dn21:2.10.3: Tayā tāta paṭhamaṃ pasāditaṃ pacchā mayaṃ Bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamimha arahantaṃ sammā-sambuddhaṃ.
dn21:2.10.4: Pettike ṭhāne ṭhapayissāmi, Gandhabba-rājā bhavissasi, Bhaddañ ca te Suriya-vaccasaṃ dammi, sā hi te abhipatthitā ti.'
dn21:2.10.5: Atha kho Sakko devānam indo pāṇinā paṭhaviṃ parāmasitvā tikkhattuṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
dn21:2.10.9: Imasmiñ ca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne Sakkassa devānam indassa virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi:
dn21:2.10.10: ‘Yaṃ kiñci samudaya-dhammaṃ sabban taṃ nirodha-dhamman' ti,
dn21:2.10.12: Iti ha Sakkena devānam indena ajjhittā pañhā puṭṭhā, te Bhagavatā vyākatā.
dn21:2.10.13: Tasmā imassa veyyākaraṇassa Sakka-pañho t' eva adhivacanan ti. SAKKA-PAÑHA-
